issue_snapshot.title: Follow-ups from #49: 3 from the review, 2 from QA
issue_snapshot.body:
What the review and QA of PR #54 (for #49) found and did not fix there — filed as it merged, one ticket for the lot. ## From the review Non-blocking findings the reviewer approved despite: a statement about severity, not a judgement that they are wrong. ### The join page h1 renders 'Join {group.name}' with no overflow-wrap treatment, so an 80-character unbroken group name widens /join/[token] past a 375px viewport. Same root-cause shape as the fixed h1s, on a route with no acceptance criterion, so it is a follow-up, not a blocker. > The join page h1 renders 'Join {group.name}' with no overflow-wrap treatment, so an 80-character unbroken group name widens /join/[token] past a 375px viewport. Same root-cause shape as the fixed h1s, on a route with no acceptance criterion, so it is a follow-up, not a blocker. > > `app/join/[token]/page.tsx:84` > > Evidence: app/join/[token]/page.tsx:84:

Join {group.name}

— no break-words/truncate; grep shows the PR does not touch this file. GROUP_NAME_MAX is 80 (lib/groups/validation.ts:21), and unbroken 80-char names are exactly what set the group/members pages to 753-1136px before this fix. > > Fix: Add break-words to that h1 (block-level inside a flex-col div, so the one-class treatment used on the group-page h1 suffices) or file it as the follow-up issue; expense-screen.tsx:56,69,85 is the same shape but already tracked as a residual risk in the work order. ### The join page's buttons re-print unbounded names with no overflow-wrap treatment: `Join ${groupName}` interpolates an up-to-80-character group name and `This is me — claim ${seat.displayName}` an up-to-80-character placeholder name, both as bare text inside inline-flex Buttons. That is the same shrink-to-fit min-content shape the PR fixes on the members top back-link (which measured 703px naive), on a route with no acceptance criterion — follow-up, not a blocker. > The join page's buttons re-print unbounded names with no overflow-wrap treatment: `Join ${groupName}` interpolates an up-to-80-character group name and `This is me — claim ${seat.displayName}` an up-to-80-character placeholder name, both as bare text inside inline-flex Buttons. That is the same shrink-to-fit min-content shape the PR fixes on the members top back-link (which measured 703px naive), on a route with no acceptance criterion — follow-up, not a blocker. > > `components/groups-panels.tsx:870` > > Evidence: components/groups-panels.tsx:870 `{`Join ${groupName}`}` inside Button and :831 `{`This is me — claim ${seat.displayName}`}` inside Button; Button renders buttonClasses() = `inline-flex items-center justify-center ...` with no min-w-0 or wrapping (components/ui.tsx:171); the enclosing Card is `flex flex-col` with no overflow clipping (components/ui.tsx:327), so nothing stops the min-content floor reaching the document. GROUP_NAME_MAX and PLACEHOLDER_NAME_MAX are both 80 (lib/groups/validation.ts:21-22). > > Fix: Give the button labels the same treatment as the members back-link label — the text in its own min-w-0 break-words span, since break-words alone on the shrink-to-fit button cannot reduce its min-content floor — or file it with the join-h1 follow-up; the claim-button instance needs the same. ### The shared ConfirmStep question paragraph interpolates 80-character group and member names with no wrapping, and it renders inline in-flow on the in-scope pages once expanded: `Remove ${displayName} from "${groupName}"` on members, `Archive "${groupName}"` / rotate / disable confirms on the group page, `Leave "${groupName}"` on members. Same unbroken-name root cause; only reachable behind a click so no AC covers it — follow-up, not a blocker. > The shared ConfirmStep question paragraph interpolates 80-character group and member names with no wrapping, and it renders inline in-flow on the in-scope pages once expanded: `Remove ${displayName} from "${groupName}"` on members, `Archive "${groupName}"` / rotate / disable confirms on the group page, `Leave "${groupName}"` on members. Same unbroken-name root cause; only reachable behind a click so no AC covers it — follow-up, not a blocker. > > `components/ui.tsx:97` > > Evidence: components/ui.tsx:97-99 `

{question}

` — no break-words; instances at components/groups-panels.tsx:496 (remove), :539 (archive), :413/:426 (rotate/disable), :766 (leave); the confirm renders as an in-flow div (inline details dropdown on members, inline panels elsewhere), not a clipping dialog, so its overflow reaches the document. > > Fix: Add break-words to the ConfirmStep question

— one place covers all five instances, the same one-class treatment as the group-page h1 precedent. ## Found by QA — pre-existing PR #54 did not introduce these, which is why they did not block it. ### Expense editor with an 80-character group name scrolls horizontally at 375px (scrollWidth 1136) **Severity** minor (as judged by QA — reassess before planning). **Expected.** > The expense editor for an 80-character-named group fits the 375px viewport (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) while still naming the group in full, the same treatment this PR gave the group and members pages. **Actual.** > At a 375px viewport document.documentElement.scrollWidth is 1136px: the whole editor page scrolls sideways. The three name-bearing elements (breadcrumb link, h1, bottom Back-to link) render the 80-character name with no overflow-wrap class. **Steps to reproduce** 1. Sign up a fresh account. 2. Create a group named 'x' * 80. 3. Open /groups//expenses/new at a 375px viewport. 4. Read document.documentElement.scrollWidth and clientWidth: 1136 vs 375. **Suspected cause.** > components/expense-screen.tsx renders {groupName} bare in three places the PR did not touch: the breadcrumb Link (~line 56), the h1 title (~line 69), and the bottom Back-to (~line 85). Verified the base commit (framework root at main) carries zero break-words in this file, so the shape predates the PR — it is the residual risk the work order left 'for a follow-up if QA reproduces it'. **Reproducible:** always ### Add-seat (and rename) success line re-prints 80-character names with no wrapping (scrollWidth 676) **Severity** minor (as judged by QA — reassess before planning). **Expected.** > Adding a maximum-length placeholder seat leaves the members page fitting the 375px viewport; the success line wraps the same way the removed-member and archived notices now do. **Actual.** > The success line 'Added <80-char name>. Share the invite link so they can claim the seat.' renders in a plain

with no wrapping; document scrollWidth is 676px at a 375px viewport until the form state clears (reload/navigate). **Steps to reproduce** 1. Sign up a fresh account and create any group. 2. Open /groups//members at a 375px viewport. 3. Fill 'Add someone by name' with 'z' * 80 and submit 'Add seat'. 4. Read scrollWidth vs clientWidth while the 'Added ...' line is showing: 676 vs 375. **Suspected cause.** > The shared StateMessage (components/ui.tsx:54-64) renders success text in

with no overflow-wrap; lib/groups/actions.ts:316 interpolates the seat displayName ('Added ...') and :233 the group name ('Renamed to ...'). Base commit verified without break-words, so pre-existing — the PR fixed the two notice

s but missed this third sibling with the identical shape. **Reproducible:** always --- **Check each one still reproduces before planning it.** They were written against the PR as it stood, and a later round can have fixed one. Some may not hold up: say so and drop them rather than implementing something that was never wrong. Split this if they turn out to be unrelated. Depends on #49.
